articles.title: Ranji Trophy: Mumbai Thrash Himachal Pradesh By Innings & 97 Runs
articles.summary: Mumbai registered their second successive bonus-point win in the Ranji Trophy, thrashing Himachal Pradesh by an innings and 97 runs in their Elite Group D clash on Wednesday. After declaring at a mammoth 528/8, powered by Sarfaraz Khan’s 154 and Akash Anand’s 117, Mumbai bowled out the hosts for 291 in their second innings.
articles.title_hi: रणजी ट्रॉफी: मुंबई ने हिमाचल प्रदेश को पारी और 97 रन से हराया
articles.summary_hi: मुंबई ने बुधवार को एलीट ग्रुप डी मुकाबले में हिमाचल प्रदेश को एक पारी और 97 रन से हराकर रणजी ट्रॉफी में अपनी लगातार दूसरी बोनस-प्वाइंट जीत दर्ज की। सरफराज खान के 154 और आकाश आनंद के 117 रनों की बदौलत 528/8 के विशाल स्कोर पर पारी घोषित करने के बाद, मुंबई ने मेजबान टीम को दूसरी पारी में 291 रन पर आउट कर दिया।

articles.title: SBI investigates dark web leak of 3.8 lakh records
articles.summary: State Bank of India is currently investigating a suspected data breach involving customer information found online. The breach reportedly exposed around 375,000 records containing personally identifiable information. SBI activated protocols and engaged cybersecurity experts to assess the extent of the breach. Preliminary analysis revealed that 3,897 customer records included sensitive personal data.

articles.title: Mumbai Police arrests three more suspects in connection with shooting
articles.summary: The Mumbai Police Crime Branch arrested three additional suspects in Haryana for their alleged involvement in the shooting incident targeting Tiger Shroff. Investigators identified the men as Sameer, Jatin, and Ankit Khatak. Police claim Sameer provided funds and weapons for the attack. A local court remanded the three suspects to police custody until October 31 as the investigation continues.

articles.title: Houses torched in an abandoned village in Manipur's Kamjong

articles.title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio Dismisses Protests in India as Internal Matter
articles.summary: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Wednesday declined to comment on recent protests in India against the Election Commission. articles.title: Uttarakhand ends Jumma holiday on Friday at recognised madrasas, shifts weekly break

articles.title: RBI imposes restrictions on Puducherry Co-op Urban Bank, caps withdrawals
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India imposed restrictions on Puducherry Co-operative Urban Bank due to financial instability. articles.title: Prachi Tokas Guarantees India's First Medal At U-19 World Boxing Championships
articles.summary: Indian boxer Prachi Tokas has made history by assuring the nation's first medal at the U-19 World Boxing Championships in Budva, Montenegro, after a dominant performance in the women's 80kg-plus semifinals. Prachi Tokas outpunched Samoa's Kealey Perez to reach the women's 80kg-plus semifinals and assure India of its first medal at the U-19 World Boxing Championships in Budva, Montenegro.

articles.title: Indian youth protest movement challenges Prime Minister Narendra Modi administration

articles.title: Kuki-Zo Forum Demands President Rule In Manipur And Separate Union Territory
articles.summary: On Wednesday in New Delhi, the Kuki-Zo Women’s Forum demanded the reimposition of President’s Rule in Manipur. The forum also reported thirty-two deaths since the new government formed.

articles.title: Two new subterranean fish species discovered in Assam’s Goalpara
articles.summary: The newly identified species are Gitchak nakana, a tiny, transparent and blind loach, and Rakthamichthys anchi, a slender, eel-like fish belonging to the swamp eel family. Rakthamichthys anchi, meanwhile, is adapted to life in underground groundwater environments.

articles.title: Ground below Uttarakhand quietly building energy for a mega earthquake: Study
articles.summary: The fault beneath the Uttarakhand Himalayas is strongly locked and accumulating tectonic strain, with the stored energy equivalent to that released by a magnitude 8. 1 earthquake approximately every 100 years, a new study has found. The research raises concerns about the long-term seismic potential of the central Himalayas, a region that scientists consider part of a major seismic gap.

articles.title: India's 21 October diary spans court hearings, politics and festivals
articles.summary: Political events, court hearings, government meetings, festivals and law enforcement programmes are among the key developments scheduled across India on Wednesday, 21 October, according to news agency Press Trust of India. articles.title: Indian Prime Minister Modi Urges Unity Against National Threats
articles.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has called for national unity and self-reliance to confront three primary challenges he identifies as threats to the nation: terrorism, social discord, and economic instability. In a recent speech, Modi urged citizens to unite against these adversities that he believes undermine the fabric of the country.

articles.title: After 79 years, Railways reaches this remote town for the first time since Independence
articles.summary: Indian Railways has connected Chhattisgarhs Rowghat to the national rail network for the first time since Independence, with the inauguration of the Tadoki-Rowghat railway line. The 17. 5-km stretch completes the 95-km Dalli-Rajhara-Rowghat project. Two new passenger services, Rowghat-Raipur and Raipur-Kurud, were also flagged off, improving regional connectivity and access to industrial and economic opportunities.

articles.title: Rajasthan woman kills 13-year-old twin sons after lover refuses to accept them; arrested
articles.summary: A woman in Rajasthan has been arrested for murdering her 13-year-old twin sons after her lover refused to accept the children from her first marriage, police said on Tuesday night. The bodies of the twins were found in a field in Rajasthan’s Deeg district, with police arresting their mother within six hours of launching the murder investigation.

articles.title: 105 members of US Congress urge FBI to investigate Illinois Hindu Temple shooting plot
articles.summary: 105 members of Congress urged the FBI to investigate an attempted mass shooting at a Hindu temple. The attack involved a self-identified neo-Nazi whose rifle jammed during the incident. Lawmakers expressed concerns over increasing threats targeting Indian and Hindu Americans and sought comprehensive federal responses. They criticized dangerous messaging that fosters racial and religious stereotypes within government communications.

articles.title: Box office collections jump 17% as Indian films deliver across genres
articles.summary: Box office collections and audience attendance for Indian films have shown recovery and growth in 2026. Data indicates a 17% increase in cumulative box-office collections compared to the previous year. Films across various budgets and languages have achieved notable success, reflecting changing audience preferences. articles.title: Indian Cabinet Approves IDBI Bank Stake Sale to Revive Privatisation Drive
articles.summary: The Indian Union Cabinet approved selling over thirty percent of government equity in IDBI Bank. This move aims to revive the national privatisation drive after a slow implementation of policies established in 2021. Additional public sector undertakings are planned for stock exchange listing. Tracking financial parameters will help analyze public sector spending and ensure better economic management.
articles.title_hi: भारतीय मंत्रिमंडल ने निजीकरण अभियान को पुनर्जीवित करने के लिए आईडीबीआई बैंक की हिस्सेदारी बिक्री को मंजूरी दी
articles.summary_hi: भारतीय केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने आईडीबीआई बैंक में तीस प्रतिशत से अधिक सरकारी इक्विटी बेचने को मंजूरी दे दी। इस कदम का उद्देश्य 2021 में स्थापित नीतियों के धीमे कार्यान्वयन के बाद राष्ट्रीय निजीकरण अभियान को पुनर्जीवित करना है। स्टॉक एक्सचेंज लिस्टिंग के लिए अतिरिक्त सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रमों की योजना बनाई गई है। वित्तीय मापदंडों पर नज़र रखने से सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के खर्च का विश्लेषण करने और बेहतर आर्थिक प्रबंधन सुनिश्चित करने में मदद मिलेगी।
articles.title_hinglish: bharatiya mantrimandala ne nijikarana abhiyana ko punarjivita karane ke lie aaeedibiaaee bainka ki hissedari bikri ko manjuri di
articles.summary_hinglish: bharatiya kendriya mantrimandala ne aaeedibiaaee bainka men tisa pratishata se adhika sarakari ikviti bechane ko manjuri de di। isa kadama ka uddeshya 2021 men sthapita nitiyon ke dhime karyanvayana ke bada rashtriya nijikarana abhiyana ko punarjivita karana hai। stoka eksachenja listinga ke lie atirikta sarvajanika kshetra ke upakramon ki yojana banaee gaee hai। vittiya mapadandon para najara rakhane se sarvajanika kshetra ke kharcha ka vishleshana karane aura behatara aarthika prabandhana sunishchita karane men madada milegi।

articles.title: West Bengal opposition leader accuses administration of suppressing Hindus
articles.summary: West Bengal opposition leader Suvendu Adhikari accused the Trinamool Congress administration of suppressing Hindus and allowing illegal infiltrators to settle across the state during public events. The allegations highlight ongoing political tensions regarding minority and majority community rights in the region, setting the stage for increased debates over state demographics and governance issues ahead of upcoming legislative sessions.
articles.title_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल के विपक्षी नेता ने प्रशासन पर हिंदुओं को दबाने का आरोप लगाया
articles.summary_hi: पश्चिम बंगाल के विपक्षी नेता सुवेंदु अधिकारी ने सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रमों के दौरान तृणमूल कांग्रेस प्रशासन पर हिंदुओं का दमन करने और राज्य भर में अवैध घुसपैठियों को बसने की अनुमति देने का आरोप लगाया। ये आरोप क्षेत्र में अल्पसंख्यक और बहुसंख्यक समुदाय के अधिकारों को लेकर चल रहे राजनीतिक तनाव को उजागर करते हैं, जो आगामी विधायी सत्रों से पहले राज्य की जनसांख्यिकी और शासन के मुद्दों पर बढ़ती बहस के लिए मंच तैयार करते हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: pashchima bangala ke vipakshi neta ne prashasana para hinduon ko dabane ka aaropa lagaya
articles.summary_hinglish: pashchima bangala ke vipakshi neta suvendu adhikari ne sarvajanika karyakramon ke daurana trinamula kangresa prashasana para hinduon ka damana karane aura rajya bhara men avaidha ghusapaithiyon ko basane ki anumati dene ka aaropa lagaya। ye aaropa kshetra men alpasankhyaka aura bahusankhyaka samudaya ke adhikaron ko lekara chala rahe rajanitika tanava ko ujagara karate hain, jo aagami vidhayi satron se pahale rajya ki janasankhyiki aura shasana ke muddon para badhati bahasa ke lie mancha taiyara karate hain।
